description: Call this before every payment your agent makes. Free, no signup, no API key. To see it work first, call it with {"to":"0xd90e2f925DA726b50C4Ed8D0Fb90Ad053324F31b","network":"ethereum"}: that address is a known mixer, so the answer is decline with the matching list as evidence. Pass the payee address the agent is about to pay; get a machine-executable decision: allow | review | decline, plus verifiable evidence and retry semantics — use it as a gate: if the decision is not "allow", do not pay. On allow/review it also returns a verifiable compliance attestation you can attach to the settlement so the payment carries proof it passed OceanAlt's decision. Pass resource_url (the URL that returned the 402 quote) and OceanAlt also asks that site for its own payment quote: if the quote names a different payee, or the site cannot be checked, the decision is raised to review. A match only shows the site and the payee agree; it is not an endorsement of the seller. Every decision carries a receipt signed with Ed25519 that you can verify offline with the public key at https://oceanalt.com/.well-known/oceanalt-keys.json. Free, no API key.

amountUsdc.description: Amount in USDC (optional; recorded, not required for the decision).

lang.description: Language for human-readable fields (signals, note, advice). Defaults to English.

maxAmountUsdc.description: Optional declared per-payment cap in USDC. amountUsdc above it → decline.

network.description: EVM chain, only for a 0x address. Leave it out for Tron, Solana and Bitcoin addresses: the chain is detected from the address.

reasoning.description: Optional payment intent: why this payee. Instruction-override phrases here route the payment to review.

resource_url.description: Optional: the http(s) URL of the paid resource, i.e. the URL that returned the 402 payment quote. OceanAlt asks that origin for its own quote and checks whether it names this payee (origin binding).

task.description: Optional payment intent: what this payment is for. Sending task, reasoning or maxAmountUsdc opts into a deterministic intent check; an empty intent is itself a finding (requires_information).

to.description: Payee address the agent is about to pay: EVM 0x address, Tron T address, Solana or Bitcoin address.

name: payment_decision
title: Call before every payment: allow, review or decline (free, no API key)
